scientific_integrity: Self-contained balance, tail and uniform Doeblin arguments; exact-rational computational checks are corroborative and finite, not replacements for proofs. The motivating discrete model and general multiplicative-map literature are credited. No independent priority or replication certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact for the original integer-state walk only at l=r=1; no claim of uniform continuum-approximation validity, larger-parameter classification, finite stationary first absolute moment, or optimal mixing exponent. The singular lattice law and discrete-scale invariance are model-specific. Generic log-periodicity is previously known.
title: Exact lattice stationarity, log-periodic tails, and uniform mixing in an accelerated random walk
